title: 拋石防波堤施工
subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
summary: 連結塊石質量、層次幾何、基床與施工量測以理解拋石防波堤。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
summaryEn: Understand rubble-mound breakwaters through stone mass, layered geometry, foundations and construction measurements. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水下有效重量」與「無因次穩定指標」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Submerged effective weight" and "Dimensionless stability indicator": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水下有效重量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Submerged effective weight: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水下有效重量」如何影響拋石防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Submerged effective weight” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rubble-mound breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 塊石在水下抵抗移動的重量應扣除浮力，材料密度與海水密度共同決定有效重度。含孔隙岩石的吸水狀態和外包體積定義需一致，乾石秤重不能不經轉換就代表水下作用。 假設岩石密度2650kg/m³、海水1025kg/m³、排水體積2m³，W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN。 體積量測應明確說明是否包含可進水開口孔隙，否則排水體積與材料密度不相容。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水下有效重量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stone resistance underwater depends on weight minus buoyancy, with both rock and water density controlling effective unit weight. Absorption state and external volume definition must be consistent; a dry weighing result is not directly the submerged action. Assume rock density2650kg/m³, seawater1025kg/m³ and displaced volume2m³. W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN. Volume measurement must state whether water-accessible pores are included; otherwise displaced volume and the selected material density are inconsistent. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Submerged effective weight” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同樣乾重量的石塊在任何水體中都有相同水下重量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水下有效重量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Submerged effective weight”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水下有效重量
knowledge.text: 塊石在水下抵抗移動的重量應扣除浮力，材料密度與海水密度共同決定有效重度。含孔隙岩石的吸水狀態和外包體積定義需一致，乾石秤重不能不經轉換就代表水下作用。
knowledge.textEn: Stone resistance underwater depends on weight minus buoyancy, with both rock and water density controlling effective unit weight. Absorption state and external volume definition must be consistent; a dry weighing result is not directly the submerged action.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同樣乾重量的石塊在任何水體中都有相同水下重量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水下有效重量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Submerged effective weight" is correct?
options: 同樣乾重量的石塊在任何水體中都有相同水下重量。
塊石在水下抵抗移動的重量應扣除浮力，材料密度與海水密度共同決定有效重度。
相同穩定數就能不看坡度與週期直接採用相同石重。
optionsEn: Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body.
Stone resistance underwater depends on weight minus buoyancy, with both rock and water density controlling effective unit weight.
The same stability number permits identical stone mass regardless of slope and period.
quiz.explanation: 塊石在水下抵抗移動的重量應扣除浮力，材料密度與海水密度共同決定有效重度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stone resistance underwater depends on weight minus buoyancy, with both rock and water density controlling effective unit weight. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水下有效重量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Submerged effective weight: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水下有效重量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Submerged effective weight” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設岩石密度2650kg/m³、海水1025kg/m³、排水體積2m³，W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume rock density2650kg/m³, seawater1025kg/m³ and displaced volume2m³. W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair stone mass with absorption state and measured volume, checking seawater sampling conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設岩石密度2650kg/m³、海水1025kg/m³、排水體積2m³，W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume rock density2650kg/m³, seawater1025kg/m³ and displaced volume2m³. W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水下有效重量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Submerged effective weight", which statement holds?
options: 只要平均坡比正確就不必另外檢查坡腳位置。
標稱石徑一樣表示塊石形狀與翻轉阻力也相同。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: A correct average slope makes separate toe-position checks unnecessary.
Equal nominal diameter implies equal shape and resistance to overturning.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水下有效重量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Submerged effective weight: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水下有效重量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Submerged effective weight” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。以獨立浮力或密度試驗驗證，並保留個別塊石資料而非只報整批平均。分別核對實體、外包與堆積體積定義。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair stone mass with absorption state and measured volume, checking seawater sampling conditions. Verify through independent buoyancy or density testing and retain individual records instead of only a batch average. Check solid, envelope and stockpile volume definitions separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。以獨立浮力或密度試驗驗證，並保留個別塊石資料而非只報整批平均。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Pair stone mass with absorption state and measured volume, checking seawater sampling conditions. Verify through independent buoyancy or density testing and retain individual records instead of only a batch average.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把鬆方堆積體積當成單塊排水體積，孔隙水會被錯算為石料；平均密度看似合理卻可掩蓋弱石和多孔石，造成水下抗力估計系統性偏高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using bulk stockpile volume as individual displaced volume counts void water as stone. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。以獨立浮力或密度試驗驗證，並保留個別塊石資料而非只報整批平均。分別核對實體、外包與堆積體積定義。
knowledge.textEn: Pair stone mass with absorption state and measured volume, checking seawater sampling conditions. Verify through independent buoyancy or density testing and retain individual records instead of only a batch average. Check solid, envelope and stockpile volume definitions separately.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。以獨立浮力或密度試驗驗證，並保留個別塊石資料而非只報整批平均。
knowledge.textEn: Pair stone mass with absorption state and measured volume, checking seawater sampling conditions. Verify through independent buoyancy or density testing and retain individual records instead of only a batch average.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水下有效重量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Submerged effective weight"?
options: 將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
堤頂平均沉陷很小就代表基床與反濾層沒有局部損傷。
optionsEn: Pair stone mass with absorption state and measured volume, checking seawater sampling conditions.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Small average crest settlement proves no local foundation or filter damage exists.
quiz.explanation: 將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair stone mass with absorption state and measured volume, checking seawater sampling conditions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水下有效重量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Submerged effective weight: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水下有效重量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Submerged effective weight” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把鬆方堆積體積當成單塊排水體積，孔隙水會被錯算為石料；平均密度看似合理卻可掩蓋弱石和多孔石，造成水下抗力估計系統性偏高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using bulk stockpile volume as individual displaced volume counts void water as stone. A plausible average can conceal weak porous pieces and systematically overestimate underwater resistance throughout the placed layer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：體積量測應明確說明是否包含可進水開口孔隙，否則排水體積與材料密度不相容。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Volume measurement must state whether water-accessible pores are included; otherwise displaced volume and the selected material density are inconsistent.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同樣乾重量的石塊在任何水體中都有相同水下重量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把鬆方堆積體積當成單塊排水體積，孔隙水會被錯算為石料；平均密度看似合理卻可掩蓋弱石和多孔石，造成水下抗力估計系統性偏高。
knowledge.textEn: Using bulk stockpile volume as individual displaced volume counts void water as stone. A plausible average can conceal weak porous pieces and systematically overestimate underwater resistance throughout the placed layer.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水下有效重量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Submerged effective weight" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若把鬆方堆積體積當成單塊排水體積，孔隙水會被錯算為石料；平均密度看似合理卻可掩蓋弱石和多孔石，造成水下抗力估計系統性偏高。
相同穩定數就能不看坡度與週期直接採用相同石重。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using bulk stockpile volume as individual displaced volume counts void water as stone.
The same stability number permits identical stone mass regardless of slope and period.
quiz.explanation: 若把鬆方堆積體積當成單塊排水體積，孔隙水會被錯算為石料；平均密度看似合理卻可掩蓋弱石和多孔石，造成水下抗力估計系統性偏高。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using bulk stockpile volume as individual displaced volume counts void water as stone. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 無因次穩定指標：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dimensionless stability indicator: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「無因次穩定指標」如何影響拋石防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dimensionless stability indicator” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rubble-mound breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 波高與有效密度及標稱石徑的比值可組織不同試驗的量級，但本身不包含坡度、波週期、透水性與容許損傷。穩定指標只能在相應實驗關係的適用範圍內解釋，不能自訂一個數字就決定石料規格。 假設Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854、H=3m、Dn=1m，Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892；此處沒有指定合格門檻。 堤頭的三維流況也不同於直線堤身，不能未經驗證共用同一穩定判據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「無因次穩定指標」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wave height relative to effective density and nominal diameter organizes test scales but omits slope, period, permeability and damage definition. Interpret this indicator within the relevant empirical relation; choosing a convenient number alone cannot establish an armour specification. Assume Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854, H=3m and Dn=1m. Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892; no acceptance threshold is assigned. Three-dimensional flow around a breakwater head differs from a straight trunk, so their stability criteria are not automatically interchangeable. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dimensionless stability indicator” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相同穩定數就能不看坡度與週期直接採用相同石重。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The same stability number permits identical stone mass regardless of slope and period." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「無因次穩定指標」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Dimensionless stability indicator”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 無因次穩定指標
knowledge.text: 波高與有效密度及標稱石徑的比值可組織不同試驗的量級，但本身不包含坡度、波週期、透水性與容許損傷。穩定指標只能在相應實驗關係的適用範圍內解釋，不能自訂一個數字就決定石料規格。
knowledge.textEn: Wave height relative to effective density and nominal diameter organizes test scales but omits slope, period, permeability and damage definition. Interpret this indicator within the relevant empirical relation; choosing a convenient number alone cannot establish an armour specification.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相同穩定數就能不看坡度與週期直接採用相同石重。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The same stability number permits identical stone mass regardless of slope and period. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「無因次穩定指標」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dimensionless stability indicator" is correct?
options: 相同穩定數就能不看坡度與週期直接採用相同石重。
孔隙率與孔隙比只是同一比例的兩種名稱。
波高與有效密度及標稱石徑的比值可組織不同試驗的量級，但本身不包含坡度、波週期、透水性與容許損傷。
optionsEn: The same stability number permits identical stone mass regardless of slope and period.
Porosity and void ratio are simply two names for the same fraction.
Wave height relative to effective density and nominal diameter organizes test scales but omits slope, period, permeability and damage definition.
quiz.explanation: 波高與有效密度及標稱石徑的比值可組織不同試驗的量級，但本身不包含坡度、波週期、透水性與容許損傷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wave height relative to effective density and nominal diameter organizes test scales but omits slope, period, permeability and damage definition. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 無因次穩定指標：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dimensionless stability indicator: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「無因次穩定指標」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dimensionless stability indicator” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854、H=3m、Dn=1m，Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892；此處沒有指定合格門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854, H=3m and Dn=1m. Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892; no acceptance threshold is assigned. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把波高定義、週期、坡度、層數與損傷指標列成試驗對照表，查明採用關係的校準範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Tabulate wave-height definition, period, slope, layers and damage metric against the calibration range of the chosen relation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854、H=3m、Dn=1m，Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892；此處沒有指定合格門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854, H=3m and Dn=1m. Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892; no acceptance threshold is assigned.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「無因次穩定指標」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Dimensionless stability indicator", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
任意基土只要粒徑比等於四就必然滿足反濾要求。
流速增加百分之十時阻力也只會增加百分之十。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
A grain-size ratio of four automatically satisfies filter requirements for every base soil.
A ten-percent increase in speed produces only ten-percent more drag.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 無因次穩定指標：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dimensionless stability indicator: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「無因次穩定指標」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dimensionless stability indicator” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把波高定義、週期、坡度、層數與損傷指標列成試驗對照表，查明採用關係的校準範圍。再以現地材料形狀和模型層次檢查哪些條件並不相同。將堤身與堤頭測試資料分開比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Tabulate wave-height definition, period, slope, layers and damage metric against the calibration range of the chosen relation. Compare actual rock shapes and model layering to identify conditions that differ. Compare trunk and head test evidence as separate cases. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把波高定義、週期、坡度、層數與損傷指標列成試驗對照表，查明採用關係的校準範圍。再以現地材料形狀和模型層次檢查哪些條件並不相同。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Tabulate wave-height definition, period, slope, layers and damage metric against the calibration range of the chosen relation. Compare actual rock shapes and model layering to identify conditions that differ.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把不同波高定義或不同損傷標準的資料混用，會讓同一穩定數代表不同風險；外觀相似的石坡仍可能因透水性和波週期差異而有不同移動模式。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing wave-height definitions or damage criteria makes one stability number represent different risks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把波高定義、週期、坡度、層數與損傷指標列成試驗對照表，查明採用關係的校準範圍。再以現地材料形狀和模型層次檢查哪些條件並不相同。將堤身與堤頭測試資料分開比較。
knowledge.textEn: Tabulate wave-height definition, period, slope, layers and damage metric against the calibration range of the chosen relation. Compare actual rock shapes and model layering to identify conditions that differ. Compare trunk and head test evidence as separate cases.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把波高定義、週期、坡度、層數與損傷指標列成試驗對照表，查明採用關係的校準範圍。再以現地材料形狀和模型層次檢查哪些條件並不相同。
knowledge.textEn: Tabulate wave-height definition, period, slope, layers and damage metric against the calibration range of the chosen relation. Compare actual rock shapes and model layering to identify conditions that differ.

quiz.question: 要驗證「無因次穩定指標」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dimensionless stability indicator"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
把波高定義、週期、坡度、層數與損傷指標列成試驗對照表，查明採用關係的校準範圍。
兩條索永遠各承受總重量的一半而不受角度影響。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Tabulate wave-height definition, period, slope, layers and damage metric against the calibration range of the chosen relation.
Two slings always carry half the weight regardless of their angle.
quiz.explanation: 把波高定義、週期、坡度、層數與損傷指標列成試驗對照表，查明採用關係的校準範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Tabulate wave-height definition, period, slope, layers and damage metric against the calibration range of the chosen relation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 無因次穩定指標：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dimensionless stability indicator: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「無因次穩定指標」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dimensionless stability indicator” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把不同波高定義或不同損傷標準的資料混用，會讓同一穩定數代表不同風險；外觀相似的石坡仍可能因透水性和波週期差異而有不同移動模式。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing wave-height definitions or damage criteria makes one stability number represent different risks. Similar-looking slopes can still develop different movement patterns because their permeability and wave periods are different. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：堤頭的三維流況也不同於直線堤身，不能未經驗證共用同一穩定判據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Three-dimensional flow around a breakwater head differs from a straight trunk, so their stability criteria are not automatically interchangeable.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相同穩定數就能不看坡度與週期直接採用相同石重。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The same stability number permits identical stone mass regardless of slope and period." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把不同波高定義或不同損傷標準的資料混用，會讓同一穩定數代表不同風險；外觀相似的石坡仍可能因透水性和波週期差異而有不同移動模式。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing wave-height definitions or damage criteria makes one stability number represent different risks. Similar-looking slopes can still develop different movement patterns because their permeability and wave periods are different.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「無因次穩定指標」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dimensionless stability indicator" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
孔隙率與孔隙比只是同一比例的兩種名稱。
把不同波高定義或不同損傷標準的資料混用，會讓同一穩定數代表不同風險；外觀相似的石坡仍可能因透水性和波週期差異而有不同移動模式。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Porosity and void ratio are simply two names for the same fraction.
Mixing wave-height definitions or damage criteria makes one stability number represent different risks.
quiz.explanation: 把不同波高定義或不同損傷標準的資料混用，會讓同一穩定數代表不同風險；外觀相似的石坡仍可能因透水性和波週期差異而有不同移動模式。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing wave-height definitions or damage criteria makes one stability number represent different risks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
